Type: rug
Name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Polypropylene Runner Rug, 2' 2" x 7' 6", Blue, Navy, Multicolor
Colors: Navy
Materials: Polypropylene
Add a sense of traditional elegance to your home with this beautiful rug. Blues, golds, and reds combine to create a delicate and captivating design. With an intricate pattern reminiscent of Victorian-era decor, this rug is also an idea complement for vintage or mid-century-modern styles. 2'2" x 7'6" Imported; 100% polypropylene pile with 100% jute backing Advanced power-loom construction for excellent value and quality Medium .5'' pile is ideal for moderate-traffic areas like bedrooms or sitting rooms Pair with rug pad (sold separately)
